tool.name: bot_music
tool.description: Search for or download real songs from the music catalog. download selects the highest match by title or downloads a candidate from an earlier search; success automatically registers complete audio suitable for sending. Only host-enabled verified sources are used. The model cannot supply download URLs or paths.

candidateSet.description: Copy candidateSet from the latest search result when selecting a specific track.

candidate.description: Copy the chosen candidates[].candidate value from that search result; a positive integer starting at 1.
